message: <input type="text" name="q"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
disabled="true" follows the house style; no change needed. (HTML itself allows only disabled="" or disabled="disabled"; browsers treat any value as on.)
